sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the instrument testing 
procedures I1, 
which must be carried out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.

This document for all types of pressure, temperature, flow, and 
level indicators.

The first draft initiated by eng. Khalid Abd 
Allah
Mohamed & eng. Mostafa Ali Kheder, accepted by technical expert eng. Hassan El-Behiry, and
approved by eng. Fathy El Sayed
Head sector of El-Kuriemat Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Gamal
Abd Elwahab UEEPC MPIS 
coordinator and inspection & quality control general director.
Safety Precautions

A
work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff
should be qualified and carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work
area is required.

Wear the personal protective equipment must used as safety 
 shoes, safety helmet, earplug, and gloves pairs...etc

Close manual
valve for Indicator line.

sections.text: Gauge Problems
Chattering

Chattering 
is a violent fluctuation of a gauge's pointer that can seriously damage a 
gauge's internal parts to prevent this throttling down the supply line until the chattering stops.

Excessive Heat in Steams Damage a 
Gauge and
 affect its accuracy to Prevent this :

Close
manual valve for pressure indicator line.

Remove
the pressure indicator from its location.

Make
Seal loops like the one pictured in figure 
1 .

This
seal reduces the amount of heat that reaches the gauge. It also protects the gauge
from rapid pressure fluctuation.
